card.name: Digits inside citation years and volumes
card.fires_on: A digit in the middle of a multi-digit year or volume number in a journal reference, usually just after the year and semicolon or inside the year itself.

modes.label: Volume after year
modes.description: The first digit of a volume number following the year and semicolon in a journal citation.

modes.label: Inside the year
modes.description: A digit within a four-digit year in a reference.

card.plain: It fires on the middle digits of years and volume numbers in reference lists.
